stay.name: Venissa Wine Resort

packages.name: A Winter Escape
packages.includes: A night in a Superior room at Casa Burano, buffet breakfast, and a 7-course tasting menu with paired wines at the starred Ristorante Venissa for two
packages.when: 2 November 2026 to 6 January 2027, nights of Monday and Thursday; some dates excluded; tourist tax extra

packages.name: Vivere Venissa
packages.includes: Three nights in a Superior room at Casa Burano (third night free), gourmet breakfast, a wine experience, a 4-course lunch or dinner with wines at the Osteria Contemporanea, and a EUR 100 credit towards lunch or dinner at the starred restaurant

stay.note: Five rooms at the wine estate on Mazzorbo, plus Casa Burano, its separate 13-room guesthouse on the island of Burano; the winter offer is the one that includes the starred restaurant.
